video_title: FULL NBA Finals Preview & Predictions: Everything You Need To Know For Knicks VS. Spurs

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: NBA logos are now painted on the court for the Finals
quotes.excerpt: it's been about 10 plus years since we've had logos on the court
quotes.quote: It's been about 10 plus years since we've had logos on the court, and I kind of thought when the NBA unveiled them, I thought maybe they would be digitally enhanced. But in fact, they are the actual logo, they're painted on the court. It's awesome.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns was impressed by seeing the Finals logo on the court
quotes.excerpt: he'd never been some place where he'd actually seen the Finals logo

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Karl-Anthony Towns today was saying that he'd never been some place where he'd actually seen the Finals logo. Like, he'd obviously seen it on TV, but he'd never been to a Finals game or anything, and he was almost kind of wow-ed a little bit by just seeing all the Finals signage, which I think is an indication that it does matter, even for the guys who are playing in it.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: It is very interesting how much of a topic of conversation, whether it's Finals at the center of court or Finals being here in the in the paint on both ends, it's interesting how much of a topic of debate that has been for years now.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim MacMahon
text_blocks.text: It gives it, you know, it does give an extra pop, heightens the the the sight, the experience.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart calls the media circus surrounding the Finals a zoo
quotes.excerpt: Josh Hart referred to it as the zoo, the media circus
quotes.quote: Josh Hart referred to it as the zoo, the media circus. And obviously, the Knicks are in as much of a fishbowl as any franchise in the NBA, just because they are in New York, they are the Knicks, all the history, all the attention that they deal with on a day-in, day-out basis. Victor Wembanyama though, maybe LeBron James is the one guy who has dealt with the hype of Victor Wembanyama from age 16 all the way into the NBA.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama admits the team is still trying to come back to earth
quotes.excerpt: he admitted that he is not come down yet and the whole team hasn't come down yet
quotes.quote: He was extraordinarily emotional when he got back here on the flight and saw Greg Popovich at the airport. And then he admitted, and I appreciate his honesty, that he is not come down yet and the whole team hasn't come down yet. That they're still trying, his phrase was, come back to earth.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitchell Robinson is questionable for Game 1 with a fractured finger
quotes.excerpt: Mitchell Robinson is questionable with a fractured right fifth metacarpal
quotes.quote: Mitchell Robinson is questionable with a fractured right fifth metacarpal. He had a small wrap on his hand. I will say, watching him during the open portion of practice, I think he's going to play and I think he's going to be fine. Mike Brown, when asked about it last week, said it didn't happen in a game and it didn't happen in a practice.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitchell Robinson likely feels a need to play through his injury
quotes.excerpt: he probably feels a need to play in the game, even if he's not 100% effective
quotes.quote: Because it didn't happen in a game or a practice, I believe that Mitch probably feels a need to play in the game, even if he's not 100% effective. He probably feels a need to play.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitchell Robinson's minutes are down due to the Knicks' small-ball shift
quotes.excerpt: he's actually playing less in the postseason than he did in the regular season
quotes.quote: Mitch has only been playing 14 minutes a game in the postseason. He's actually playing less in the postseason than he did in the regular season, partially because the Knicks have changed their style of play a little bit and they've been playing more five-out because it's been working.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Jared Schwartz reports that Victor Wembanyama must be made to run
quotes.excerpt: you don't necessarily have to be physical with Victor, you have to make him run
quotes.quote: It was Jared Schwartz who wrote that story, who was a Spur until March 1st, got bought out, went to the Knicks. He hasn't played at all in the postseason, but knows Victor Wembanyama. And what he said, among other things, about the scouting report is, you don't necessarily have to be physical with Victor, you have to make him run. That where he wears out isn't through physicality necessarily, but by mileage.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Spurs have played more playoff games than the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: the Spurs have played four more playoff games than the Knicks
quotes.quote: The Cavs had played four more playoff games by the time they got to the Knicks. The Spurs have played four more playoff games than the Knicks. At some point, it's going to matter, don't you think?

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: The youth of the Spurs could be an advantage in the Finals
quotes.excerpt: the youth of their legs could be an advantage
quotes.quote: I do think you have to at least consider the youth of the Spurs in that sense. People are asking about their inexperience, it's a disadvantage, but the youth of their legs could be an advantage.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The Spurs are more dangerous when Victor Wembanyama is shooting threes
quotes.excerpt: they are more dangerous when he's going to the rim
quotes.quote: I'm trying not to be a stick in the mud, but I just think they are more dangerous when he's going to the rim.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon agrees that the Spurs need to be physical with Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: I would agree, but I'm just saying there's not a direct correlation to Wembanyama launching a ton of threes
quotes.quote: I would agree, but I'm just saying there's not a direct correlation to Wembanyama launching a ton of threes and them losing. It is, you know, they also won basically 80% of their games all season, so you can really write it up any way you want.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon is embedding with the Spurs for the Finals
quotes.excerpt: I'm hanging with the Jackals. That's Wembanyama's little hand-picked
quotes.quote: I'm hanging with the Jackals. That's Wembanyama's little hand-picked... I did get a temporary exception that was negotiated actually at the Tipsy Tiki.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon predicts the Spurs will win the series in seven
quotes.excerpt: I'm going to pick Spurs in seven
quotes.quote: If I'm going to hang with the Jackals, I got to pick the Spurs. Tim Legler, I'm going to pick Spurs in seven. I do think this is going to be a great series.
